objectives: minimize 1 / joint-wind expected complete-farm power in kW
minimize joint-wind expected mean A-weighted level over four monitors in dBA
constraint: max(0,(declared turbine plus effective-land cost - paper budget)/paper budget)
physical_fes: one complete energy, acoustic, cost, and constraint evaluation of one layout

wake_completion.paper_authority: supplement Eqs. 1-8 define the pairwise 3D velocity field
wake_completion.multi_wake_rule: compute the ambient speed at the downstream target elevation once, combine each upstream pair's absolute wake-only deficit by fixed-order root-sum-square, then subtract the combined absolute deficit
wake_completion.terrain_shear_rule: apply downstream terrain shear once through v_ref*((z_target-z_reference+z_hub)/z_hub)^alpha
wake_completion.rejected_double_counting: do not convert Eq. 7 pair velocity to a fractional deficit and then multiply a second terrain-shear factor
wake_completion.quality_status: declared quality-sensitive completion with zero-wake, far-crosswind, and one-upstream invariants

parallel_contract.cpu: persistent team assigns independent complete layouts to workers
parallel_contract.required_equality: all returned scientific doubles from the same binary are bitwise equal with configured one-thread and twenty-thread teams
parallel_contract.participation_boundary: configured team size is recorded; actual distinct worker participation is not claimed

semantic_hash_contract.coverage: analytic-terrain coefficients, cell-center offset and mapping rule; hub, rotor, thrust, turbulence, shear exponent and minimum shear base; wake coefficients, exponents, Gaussian scale and multi-wake rule; power-curve constants; acoustic bands, weights, absorption, source levels, velocity exponents, monitor height and minimum distance; turbine, land, area and constraint rules; physical-FES rule; budget and every CaseData field
semantic_hash_contract.change_rule: any scientific-constant or rule change must alter the computed hash and requires deliberate regeneration of all six frozen hashes

fixed_layout_oracle.comparison: absolute plus relative tolerance across supported compilers, libm implementations, and architectures

claim_boundary: This is a declared structured proxy. It does not reproduce the unavailable Zhangbei terrain, wind, monitor, acoustics, cost arrays, or reported Pareto fronts.
